headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 4, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Max Meyer earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Detroit Tigers took down the Tampa Bay Rays 7-2, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Troy Melton dominating on the mound. The Chicago White Sox shut out the Minnesota Twins 8-0, with Andrew Benintendi leading the offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The New York Mets secured a 7-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Freddy Peralta earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Joe Mantiply has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left knee inflammation, and will be sidelined for an extended period. Travis d'Arnaud has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with right foot plantar fasciitis. Matt Gage has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 2 with right knee inflammation. Other injured players include Rob Zastryzny, Nick Sogard, Jonathan Heasley, Braden Shewmake, and Carlos Correa.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Minnesota Twins traded right-handed pitcher Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Detroit Tigers traded right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.
